blocks.text: The module docstring defines the three event types, sanitized error contract, and content-handling rules. Imports remain lightweight and provider SDKs are intentionally absent.
blocks.title: Adapter contract and safety boundary

blocks.text: Regular expressions and fixed vocabularies constrain protocol values. ToolSpec validates a tool's name, description, and input schema, while load_tool_definitions reads and sorts JSON definitions.
blocks.title: Protocol constants and tool definitions

blocks.text: TextDelta, ToolCall, and Usage are immutable event records. ToolCall enforces the invariant that usable calls have dict arguments and errored calls have no arguments.
blocks.title: Stream event records

blocks.text: Message validates conversation roles and tool-message requirements. ModelRequest freezes message and tool sequences and checks tool_choice; Completion stores a collected stream.
blocks.title: Messages, requests, and completions

blocks.text: Helpers extract HTTP status and numeric retry-after values. ModelAdapterError stores classified recovery metadata while using a sanitized public message, and _BucketOnly supplies generic bucket text.
blocks.title: Provider error normalization

blocks.text: Concrete adapters implement the abstract stream method and yield ModelEvent values. collect consumes that stream, concatenates text, gathers tool calls and usage, and preserves the event sequence.
blocks.title: Async adapter interface and collection

gotchas: ToolCall arguments and content are treated as sensitive protocol content and are not logged here.
Usage is expected to be the final successful stream event, but reported=False distinguishes missing provider usage.
collect propagates exactly what adapter.stream raises.

purpose: Adapters implement this interface so the agent loop can consume text, tool calls, and usage without knowing provider wire formats. The module validates content shapes, normalizes provider errors into safe ModelAdapterError instances, and can collect a stream for non-streaming callers.
side_effects: may expose provider metadata in error objects without provider text
summary: Defines the provider-neutral request, event, completion, and error contracts for the code agent.
